_about: Discoveries a kingdom's scholars can make (Data.Research.discoveries). cost: research points; needs: discoveries that must come first; effects: what it changes for the kingdom that knows it -- harvest (share more grain), output (share more from every workshop), tool_wear (share less wear on Tools; negative), sickness (share less harm from sickness; negative), contagion (share less spreading; negative), siege (share faster siege works), tax (share more taxes), research (share faster research). Effects add up across discoveries.

Three-Field Rotation.about: a third of the fields rest each year, and the land gives more

Heavy Plough.about: an iron share and a mouldboard turn the heavy soils

Water Wheels.about: the rivers turn the mills and drive the hammers

Hardened Tools.about: quenched and tempered edges that keep

Herbal Lore.about: the herbs that ease fevers and fluxes, written down

Physicians' Learning.about: clean water, the sick kept apart, and learned physicians

Siegecraft.about: trebuchets, mines and the art of breaching walls

Ledgers.about: double-entry books, and fewer coins slip through the crown's fingers

Paper and Ink.about: cheap paper, and scholars who write more than they forget

Printing Press.about: books by the hundred, and learning for many
